name: initial-storage-schema
description: Create the original PostgreSQL persistence tables before action-identity enforcement.
statements: CREATE TABLE casino_schema_versions (component VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, applied_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE casino_players (player_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, player_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE casino_ledger (sequence_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, ledger_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, ts VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, player_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, game VARCHAR(64) NULL, round_id VARCHAR(128) NULL, transaction_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, balance_before DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, balance_after DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, details_json JSONB NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_casino_ledger_player FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES casino_players(player_id))
CREATE INDEX idx_casino_ledger_player_sequence ON casino_ledger (player_id, sequence_id)

CREATE TABLE casino_history (sequence_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, timestamp VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, game VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, round_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, player_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, bet_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, bet_label VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, payout DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, balance_after DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, details_json JSONB NOT NULL, schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_casino_history_game_sequence ON casino_history (game, sequence_id)
CREATE TABLE casino_documents (document_key VARCHAR(191) PRIMARY KEY, payload_json JSONB NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
